top_signals.title: Treasury Rally Gets New Boost as Election Hammers the AI Trade
top_signals.summary: Wall Street sees the Treasury market emerging as a winner from the Democratic landslide in the US midterm elections, giving traders another reason to rethink this year’s sharp selloff.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Democrat shaping AI policy bought chip stocks despite backing congressional trading ban
top_signals.summary: Rep. Josh Gottheimer disclosed new AI-linked stock purchases months after voting for a congressional trading ban, as Democrats prepare to regulate the industry.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: The Global Race to Harness Solar Power From Space
top_signals.summary: Several countries around the globe are racing to develop space-based solar power (SBSP) systems to harness solar power from space. On Earth, solar power has become a popular form of renewable energy production. However, tapping solar power is limited by night, cloud cover, atmospheric conditions, and seasonality. Roughly 30 per cent of all incoming solar radiation never makes it to ground level. Meanwhile, in space, the sun shines constantly. For this reason, several governments are exploring the potential to develop SBSP projects that will help…
